svg.text: the design (Liu et al. 2024, §2): the same question, the answer document moved
K documents in the context; K − 1 are distractors without the answer;
accuracy is plotted against the answer's position
demo 3 replaces documents by UUID key–value pairs (§4 of the paper):

g.text: position of the answer: beginning → middle → end
a U: best at the ends, worst in the middle —
the shape the paper reports; demo 3 measures ours

svg.text: the abstract's two claims, not re-measured here: the drop in the middle is large, and it appears even in models "explicitly designed" for long context
a needle test with one exact string and no distractors is this design at its easiest settings — hence "lower bound"
